<function name="DropObject" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>Drops any object the player is currently holding with either Gravity Gun, Physics Gun or `+use` (E key)

See also <page>Entity:ForcePlayerDrop</page>.
</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
	
		<arg name="entity" type="Entity" default="nil">Only drop if the held entity is this entity. If left blank, drop any held entity.</arg>
</args>
</function>
